description: Substrate value of the sigma1sigma2 Stokes entry of 4_1 — the entry whose q->0 value is the integer A_omega = 3 used by the T4/T5 chain (GGM eq 60, S+(0) = [[1,3],[0,1]]). Computed from the OCR-free certified sandwich (qbeta_g3_ggm_stokes_41) at q-order 1600 with the honest ladder guard. Channel-correctness audit: the qou-awpk / W2 winding results are sigma1sigma1 (substrate value 0.4276), so they are cross-channel to A_omega; the x-refinement of sigma1sigma2 is not proven in the literature for 4_1. Scope-(a) measurement; nothing fitted, nothing wired, T5 A_omega field untouched.

data.ratio_series_diverges_note: the printed S12/S11 ratio series (3, 9, 75, 642, 5580, 48558, 422865, ...) grows ~8.7x/order, radius ~0.115: it diverges at q_sub = 0.9009 and must not be summed; the quotient of the two convergent entry values is the meaningful object

channel_correctness.consequence: qou-awpk/W2 winding results are cross-channel to A_omega; the sigma1sigma2 x-refinement is not proven for 4_1 in the literature — the honest gap

data.verdict: σ₁σ₂ SUBSTRATE MEASUREMENT (the channel that actually carries the T4/T5 A_ω): S⁺₁₂(q̃_sub) = 1.58516366292 [13d], i.e. 0.528388× the q→0 integer 3; the value-ratio S⁺₁₂/S⁺₁₁ = 3.70673484647 (1.23558× 3). Scope-(a) MEASUREMENT of how far the Stokes constant has deformed at the substrate — NOT a derivation of A_ω and NOT wired; the T5 A_ω field is untouched. Channel-correctness note: the qou-awpk/W2 winding results (ϑ-dependence, bar-odd part, Im-ratio −6.03) belong to σ₁σ₁, whose substrate value is 0.4276, so they are cross-channel to A_ω and cannot settle it. The x-refinement of σ₁σ₂ is NOT proven in the literature for 4₁ — that is the honest gap between this measurement and the winding programme.
